description: Source code for the GenerateTheme command class in Drupal, which generates new themes based on starterkits and default markup.

classes.name: GenerateTheme
classes.description: A command class for generating new Drupal themes based on starterkits and default markup.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for GenerateTheme, initializes the root path.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up command name, description, arguments, and options.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the command, sets the theme name option if not provided, and changes directory to Drupal root.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that generates a new theme from a starterkit, including copying files, renaming, and post-processing.

methods.name: getUniqueTmpDirPath
methods.description: Generates a unique temporary directory path.

methods.name: getThemeInfo
methods.description: Retrieves theme extension info by theme name.

methods.name: createFilesFinder
methods.description: Creates a Symfony Finder instance for files in a directory.

methods.name: loadStarterKitConfig
methods.description: Loads and merges starterkit configuration from YAML file.

methods.name: getStarterKitVersion
methods.description: Determines the version string of the starterkit, handling dev versions and git commits.

methods.name: namePatterns
methods.description: Generates various filename and label patterns for theme naming conventions.
